notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Kari is finally fully released! [/h1]
After almost a year of development the game is out! We've worked and fixed and polished and are extremely proud to share with you the final product of our efforts.

We're incredibly grateful to have such amazing support from a dedicated community that loves Kari as much as we do. We hope you all and many more will explore Vanaheim with her and enjoy her adventure.

[h1]And now...[/h1]
Kari is a student project by a team of students from the Breda University of Applied Sciences. We've reached the end of the duration for this project and polished and fixed past that even. However now the year is over for us and Team Unmanagable is disbanding to go on internships, holidays and pursue personal projects. Thus, Kari will no longer be updated, the game as it is live now is our final product.

Thank you all for your continued support. We hope you enjoy Kari and find enjoyment in Vanaheim.

notes.title: A new update will come soon
notes.content:
The next big update is coming soon. Maybe you have noticed that the steam pages show achievements?  Yes, it's right the next content update will bring achievements! 
The update will also address the major feedback points we have gotten from the community. This update will generally enhance the playability of our game as well as the stability. We have also polished the set dressing and added more audio feedback.

notes.content:
[i][b]Notice[/b][/i]: Since we are in active development during beta we sometimes make changes that are incompatible with the previous version of the game invalidating your save file.

[h2]Additonal Areas[/h2]
The first area we've added takes Kari North and high up into the mountains that belong to Uller, the one who started it all. Manoeuvre your way over and around sheer cliffs, meet the forge masters of Kliftoft, and make your way through the inhospitable lands that Uller rules.

The second area takes you to a place long abandoned, but not quite forgotten. On the Ancient Battlefield of a time where Gods faced off against each other, Kari shall have to find her way around the everlasting effects of this struggle, meet the nomadic Valkans, and face several divine entities such as Mimir and the menacing Lorelei.

notes.title: Patch Notes version 0.1.175184.28.s
notes.content:
[u][b]Notice[/b][/u]: Since we are in active development during beta we sometimes make changes that are incompatible with the previous version of the game invalidating your save file.
 
[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated lighting
[*] Updated water visuals
[*] Updated various textures
[*] Njord's pond visual update
[*] Trees fade out faster
[*] Runa no longer has an infinite stash of seeds
[*] You can now drop Forest Stew
[*] Raven warns the player when trying to enter the mist in the first area
[*] Menu's no longer open when interacting with the shrine to prevent various bugs
[*] Quest no longer shows in top left. Quest are still visible in quest log by pressing "Q"
[*] New action log
[*] Some NPC's are relocated
[/list]

[h2]Control changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] “P” no longer pauses the game, "Esc" is now the only dedicated pause button
[*] “O” no longer cancels, “C” now cancels, just like “Esc” and “Backspace”
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The blessing/health now drains as intended, and will require Shrines to restore again
[*] Berries have lost the power of flight
[*] ESC now is functional in the menu settings
[*] Spawning dialogue no longer crashes the game
[*] Removed brightness setting until issues are resolved
[/list]
